newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close steady, trading dull.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close steady, trading dull.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed steady on Monday and trading was dull as most investors were away on holiday, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.21 points lower at 591.28. Hatton National fell 10 rupees to 225 and Magpeck one to 3.75.
"Small retail investors are completely out due to the holiday season," said Dimuthu Abeysekera, a trader at Allied Phillips Stock Brokers.
The main trades were 77,000 John Keells Holdings at 195 rupees, 30,000 Grain Elevators at 10, 30,500 Lanka Tiles at 17.25 and 11,900 National Development Bank at 196.
"Even a majority of foreign and local institutional investors are on holiday. But some are using the current lethargy to buy for the longer term," Abeysekera said.
Brokers said some investors were buying stocks to build up their long-term positions, given the prospect of improved corporate earnings in 1997.
A parcel of 1.7 million Horana Plantations was introduced on an all-or-none basis, and will be held on bid for three days.
